_doc: Frozen BEFORE any archive is inspected (Protocol Week 3). Changing anything here after the draw requires a logged amendment in docs/amendments.md.

coercion_proxy.note: No public dataset measures locally deployable coercion. Candidates: national military personnel per capita (NMC) or a GeoSDM-territory distance-to-capital/garrison proxy. PI must choose and document before the draw.

cells: info{high,low} x coercion{high,low} x escalation{escalating,non_escalating} = 8 cells
allocation: equal (3 per cell); a cell with fewer eligible disputes contributes all of them and the shortfall is reassigned one at a time to the cell with the largest remaining frame, ties broken by cell name
replacement_rule: Only for documented inaccessibility recorded in archival_search_log.csv (result=access_denied for all planned repositories). Replacement = next unselected dispute in the pre-drawn random order of the same cell. Original row stays with status=unavailable.
status_2026_10_14: Not run. Superseded for the pilot phase by config/pilot_frames.json (structured within-country frames). If a global draw is later needed, provisional strata could use Hanson-Sigman infcap/milpercap, but outputs/provisional_strata_support.csv shows 0-1 escalating episodes in high-infcap cells.
